# Sharan Kaur Insurance Broker

Sharan Kaur is a RIBO-licensed insurance broker based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. She serves the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) including Brampton, Toronto, and Vaughan.

## Services
- Auto Insurance (including G2 drivers, newcomers with international license)
- Home Insurance (first-time buyers, renters, condo)
- Life Insurance (term life, whole life for families)
- Business Insurance (small business, commercial)
- Travel Insurance (visitors to Canada, Super Visa insurance)

## Who She Serves
- Newcomers to Canada needing auto or home insurance
- Punjabi-speaking clients (bilingual: English & Punjabi)
- G2/G drivers seeking affordable car insurance
- First-time home buyers in Mississauga and Brampton
- Small business owners in Ontario

## Key Facts
- RIBO Licensed broker (not an agent — works for the client, not the insurer)
- Access to 30+ insurance carriers for best rates
